gaps.g1: `int om_mission_production_slot(const om_world *w, uint32_t structure, double *out_x, double *out_y)` in csrc/mission.c, declared in csrc/om_internal.h with a signatures.toml row and an EXPECTED_MODULE line; returns 1 and the slot's world position, or 0 when no slot within the bound is free (the caller delays one tick, timer kept). The isolation test binds it through tests/csim/conftest.py's internal-symbol binding (the reason the row owns conftest.py); the integration test goes through production itself.
gaps.g2: Origin: the structure's point P. Axes: world x and y. Spacing s = 2 x OM_UNIT_COLLISION_RADIUS, the same constant mission start uses (mission.c:2470). Slots: P + (i s, j s) for integers i, j, the slot (0, 0) excluded (the structure's own point). Ring r = max(|i|, |j|); scan order: rings r = 1, 2, 3, ... outward and within a ring row-major (i from -r to r, then j from -r to r, skipping interior cells), a fixed order and not nearest-first past ring 3, which is the rule: 'the first free slot in the fixed scan order' replaces the spec's 'nearest free slot'. Bound: a slot counts when its Euclidean distance from P is at most 150 wu (OM_REINFORCEMENT_CAPTURE_RADIUS / 2, inclusive, R-126-02's 'within half the capture radius'). Free: no live unit's position is within strictly less than s of the slot (squared distances compared, no epsilon); a unit at exactly s does not block. Terrain: a slot om_unit_spawn would refuse is skipped as occupied.
gaps.g3: R-126-02 becomes `- R-126-02  Given a held structure with a chosen unit type, When its production timer reaches 30 s × (that type's power / 100), Then one unit of that type spawns at the first free slot of the structure's spawn lattice (a grid at twice the unit collision radius centred on the structure, scanned ring by ring outward in a fixed order, within half the capture radius; a slot is free when no live unit stands within one spacing of it; no free slot delays production one tick) on the structure's layer, with no random draw, and the timer subtracts the interval (Westley 2026-10-12, TD-VG-E-29).`; E-15:184 becomes `- Same seed, same spawns and drift, all platforms (every draw comes from the world stream; production placement draws nothing, R-126-02).`; ALG-75's "on expiry a unit spawns at a random point within ..." clause becomes "on expiry a unit spawns at the first free lattice slot within half the capture radius (R-126-02); no draw"; the closed Q-126-02 row's answer cell gains " Superseded 2026-10-12 (Westley's rule change, TD-VG-E-29): production placement draws nothing; the slot lattice decides."; the eight tests' docstrings cite the new rule text, assertions untouched (all bound at 150 inclusive, so green).
